correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no standard for shape spectra.

brainlife.desc: Laplace-Beltrami spectrum of 3D surface meshes: eigenvalues per surface (spectrum.json), optionally eigenvectors (eigenvectors.mat).
brainlife.name: neuro/laplace_beltrami_spectrum

original.desc: Output from Laplace Beltrami Spectrum App

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Shape analysis and comparison of tract or structure surfaces.

**Not for:** Comparing spectra from meshes with very different resolution or decimation.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.laplace_beltrami_spectrum.json

files.desc: JSON of Laplace-Beltrami eigenvalues per surface.
MATLAB file of eigenvectors per surface (optional).

identifying_risks: Shape spectra of brain structures can act as individual fingerprints
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Do not release alongside identifiable data without review
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when spectra are used as shape fingerprints (e.g. BrainPrint) to identify individuals

intended_use: Shape analysis and comparison of tract or structure surfaces.
not_suitable_for: Comparing spectra from meshes with very different resolution or decimation.

outputs_of.name: Laplace Beltrami Spectrum: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
